newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Jan 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Jan 2.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Thursday:
- An Israeli soldier with a history of mental problems opened fire on a crowded Palestinian market on Wednesday.
- Despite recent signs that negotiations to end the hostage crisis at the Japanese Ambassador's residence in Lima, Peru, were stalled, Marxist guerrillas released seven of their 81 captives.

- The timetable now set for the House to weigh the fate of Speaker Newt Gingrich has put new pressure on Republican lawmakers, who must decide, in a virtual vacuum of information, about his ethics transgressions and whether to retain him as speaker.
- A week of storms has claimed at least 11 lives in Oregon and Washington.
